title: Регитра 1: Структура экзамена
description_en: Basic terminology for the Regitra practical driving exam.

title: Регитра 2: Части автомобиля (20 вопросов)
description_en: The "20 questions before Regitra": the examiner asks 3 of them at random. Failing to show one is a critical mistake.

title: Регитра 3: Жидкости и техобслуживание
description_en: Half of the "20 questions" are about fluids. The examiner opens the hood and asks you to point them out.

title: Регитра 4: Системы безопасности
description_en: An unfastened seat belt = a critical mistake = the exam is over.

title: Регитра 5: Манёвры
description_en: Special category B maneuvers on the Regitra test ground.

title: Регитра 6: Команды экзаменатора
description_en: ~90% of what the examiner will say in 90 minutes. The highest-payoff block.

title: Регитра 8: Критические ошибки
description_en: One mistake like this and the exam is over. A small block with a huge payoff.
